add_candidate.title: How to Add a Candidate
steps: 1. Open the Candidate Management view from the left sidebar.
2. Click the orange '[+ Add Candidate]' button at the top right.
3. Enter the candidate's Full Name, Email, and Target Role.
4. Upload candidate's resume (PDF/DOCX) or paste resume text for automatic skill parsing.
5. Click 'Save & Parse Profile' to generate AI match scores.

generate_portal_link.title: How to Generate Candidate Portal Interview Link
steps: 1. Go to Candidate Management and click on a candidate's card to open their Candidate Dossier.
2. Click the orange '[GENERATE CANDIDATE PORTAL LINK]' button in the Dossier header.
4. Email or message the link directly to the candidate for seamless access.

shortlist_override.title: How to Shortlist a Candidate or Override AI Threshold
steps: 1. Open the Candidate Dossier or Pipeline View.
3. Click '[Shortlist Candidate]' or '[Advance to Take-Home Assignment]'.
4. Confirm the manual override note when prompted by the system.

adjust_ai_weights.title: How to Adjust AI Scoring Weights
steps: 1. Click 'Settings' in the left sidebar menu.
3. Adjust sliders for Skills, Experience, Education, and Projects (must sum to 100%).
4. Click 'Save Calibration Matrix' to recalculate future candidate match scores.
